feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Black and tan coonhound Rocker is top dog at the 2026 National Dog Show
entry.summary: Around 2,000 dogs competed in the latest edition of the National Dog Show, a beloved Thanksgiving tradition hosted by the Kennel Club of Philadelphia and broadcast by NBC.

entry.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
entry.summary: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

entry.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
entry.summary: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

entry.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
entry.summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

entry.title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
entry.summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

entry.title: A dish with a story, Thanksgiving with culinary historian Michael Twitty
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.

entry.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
entry.summary: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.

entry.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
entry.summary: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

entry.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
entry.summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".

entry.title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after the QB rips coach Mike McCarthy on TV
entry.summary: The move capped a chaotic 18 hours in which the team announced it was benching the 42-year-old future Hall of Famer for backup Mason Rudolph ahead of Friday's visit from Denver.
